acceptance_criteria: Traces to its accepted system anchor and is verified by its named checks.
statement: Verification evidence and logs **shall** be repository-owned, bounded, and public-safe, and **shall** exclude credentials, private addresses, unrestricted payloads, proprietary source excerpts, and sensitive deployment or host-specific values.
title: Repository-owned, bounded, public-safe evidence
verification_intent: public-safety inspection of the report, work products, and bounded logs
